## Purpose

Describe the engineering outcome this PR advances. Include only the detail needed to review the current stage.

## Scope

- [ ] One coherent change
- [ ] No unrelated refactor
- [ ] Public contract changes documented
- [ ] No unnecessary forward-looking roadmap detail

## Quality gate

- [ ] Tests added/updated where applicable
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes
- [ ] `ruff format --check src tests` passes
- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] Precursor gate is complete and green

## Commercial/IP check

- [ ] No secrets, private keys, credentials, customer data, protected data, or private roadmap material
- [ ] I identified every third-party source, copied code block, model, dataset, binary, artifact, or new dependency introduced or changed
- [ ] Donor source is recorded in `docs/DONOR_LEDGER.md` with canonical source, exact tag/commit, governing license, copyright, K5 paths, modifications, notice obligations, and review conclusion
- [ ] Required third-party notices are preserved and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` is updated where applicable
- [ ] No GPL/AGPL, source-available, non-commercial, research-only, evaluation-only, no-license, or otherwise ambiguous material is incorporated without explicit review
- [ ] I have the legal right to contribute all original material in this PR
- [ ] Third-party material is not represented as K5-owned code

## External material and provenance

List external components/material introduced or changed, or write `None`.

For donor source, provide the upstream URL plus exact tag/commit/checksum. For package-only dependencies, provide the package/version and governing license.
